### Interactive Notes

Interactive Notes are the primary instructional materials I create for my classes. They are designed to promote active engagement and help students take organized, concept‑driven notes that reinforce their understanding of core economic principles.

### Problem Set

Problem Sets are more than practice questions. They are designed to foster collaboration and active learning as students work together in small groups to analyze economic problems, compare their reasoning, and discuss solutions during class.
